latest_release.name: v2 design (v4.0.0)
latest_release.body:
This version is the first stable release of the improved major redesign of OSR since it's inception over 5 years ago. See the [project page on Hackaday](https://hackaday.io/project/192609-nasa-jpl-open-source-rover-off-the-shelf-edition) for details. We expect several documentation updates to happen post-release, but the most important parts should be present.
